mapper.sql: share_id, session_id, workspace_id, owner_user_id, status, expires_at, lock_version, trace_id, created_at, updated_at, revoked_at
mapper.select: select share_id, user_id, unified_auth_id, username, can_chat, status, shared_at, updated_at, removed_at from session_share_memberships where share_id = #{shareId} order by id

select sh.share_id, sh.session_id, sh.workspace_id, s.title as session_title, sh.owner_user_id, owner.unified_auth_id as owner_unified_auth_id, owner.username as owner_username, member.shared_at, sh.expires_at, member.can_chat, case when s.status = 'ARCHIVED' then 'SESSION_ARCHIVED' when member.status = 'REMOVED' then 'REMOVED' when sh.status = 'REVOKED' then 'REVOKED' when sh.expires_at <= current_timestamp then 'EXPIRED' else 'ACTIVE' end as access_status from session_share_memberships member join session_shares sh on sh.share_id = member.share_id join sessions s on s.session_id = sh.session_id join users owner on owner.user_id = sh.owner_user_id where member.user_id = #{userId} order by member.updated_at desc, member.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.insert: insert into session_share_audit_events( audit_event_id, share_id, session_id, workspace_id, actor_user_id, execution_owner_user_id, action, resource_type, resource_id, resource_path_sha256, outcome, error_code, trace_id, occurred_at ) values ( #{event.auditEventId}, #{event.shareId.value}, #{event.sessionId.value}, #{event.workspaceId.value}, #{event.actorUserId.value}, #{event.executionOwnerUserId.value}, #{event.action}, #{event.resourceType}, #{event.resourceId}, #{event.resourcePathSha256}, #{event.outcome}, #{event.errorCode}, #{event.traceId}, #{event.occurredAt} )
